# GOTX

> Managed IT for small businesses and home offices. Live site: https://gotx.uk

GOTX Connect Ltd trades as GOTX. The public site on gotx.uk is managed IT and network infrastructure, centred on Reading RG2 (Berkshire and nearby counties). Contact: info@gotx.uk

Preferred citation: GOTX, https://gotx.uk
Use: search, citation, and answers about these public pages.
